name: Salmon Burger with Dill, Caper Aioli & Spinach-Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 (7.5 oz) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)

Drain salmon, place in a medium bowl, and flake with a fork; add eggs, bread crumbs, mayo, and spices. Stir to combine the salmon mixture, form into 4 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; mince capers. Place both in a small bowl, add mayo, and stir to combine the aioli; set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add salmon patties and cook until browned and warmed through, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples; add to the bowl along with spinach and cranberries. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
To assemble the burgers, spread the bottom half of each bun with aioli; layer with a salmon patty and the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
